blocks.title: Run Xiaohongshu tasks across multiple accounts
blocks.description: Keep several accounts signed in and let the Agent route each MCP task to the selected account, concurrently and without manual switching.

items.title: Install and enable the plugin
items.description: The plugin prepares its pinned local Xiaohongshu service.

items.title: Sign in with QR code
items.description: Start sign-in from the ability detail page and scan the displayed QR code.

items.title: Add multiple accounts
items.description: Add accounts from the Xiaohongshu account workspace. Each MCP tool can specify account_id; omitted account_id keeps using the active account.

blocks.content: 小红书账号会话保存在插件专属数据中。请遵守小红书的账号和自动化使用规则，不要在多个网页端同时登录同一账号。
